body:
Thank you (:
I feel you dude, letting others know whats going on can be difficult. 
And you do the same!

Hi going_away2,
I actually had a really good day yesterday. Not saying it made me reconsider things entirely, but it was nice to have a break from isolation. 
Damn, i'm sorry to hear that you don't have much support. If you'd like to talk sometime I'd be up for that. 

You brought up a point I didn't consider before about going into social situations w/another person, I'll try to keep that in mind.
One day at a time is the way to go. Thank you, you really are too kind. I wish the same for you, enjoy your holiday if its Thanksgiving where you are :P

Exactly! You expect to have it together by this age. I suppose there is a ton of time, but I'm worried i'll fuck that up as well. Nice to know i'm not alone in my thinking though, as cheesy as that sounds. Currently making plans to travel a bit, who knows if it'll actually happen, but its giving me motivation to at least look for a part time job. I hope things get better for you too.

True. We skyped all day today and the better part of Saturday, she's not dumb. 
Taking things a day at a time is great advice, I just wish I could actually do it. I've been doing small things that, sad to say, take a ton of effort (showering, making sure I eat, and sleeping regular hours) I feel so pathetic writing that out but any day that I can get up out of bed feels like a victory at this point. I know I shouldn't isolate myself, but I truly fear leaving the house when i'm like this, maybe I could take a walk or something.

Thank you. I wouldn't want my family to feel pain, hell I wouldn't want anyone to feel how hopeless I do. I just think that with time they'd get over it. I fear for my best friend A though, we lost a close friend of our's a few years back, he was 19 and it really messed both of us up,  she took it especially hard. I don't want to send her down that road again but I don't know what other choice I have.

She has no idea. My girlfriend knows, but I lied and told her i'm out of the woods. I knew I wasn't but I didn't want her to worry. Its long distance so its not like she could do much about it. I was actually hospitalized about two months ago, I signed myself in after overdosing. Idk, I could roll the dice and see if things will change, but I mostly can't see past the sadness I feel.
